subject: I
fact: I file a thought about the procedural compromise of following Vareth's path as proof of the Bahamutian theory.
source_quote: I file that thought for later.

subject: I
fact: I believe I handled the theological discussion competently.
source_quote: I feel like I handled that competently,

subject: I
fact: I had not previously been aware that I actually thought anything about the nature of the universe.
source_quote: I had not previously been aware that I actually thought anything about this.

subject: I
fact: I notice that none of the three schools of thought quite fit what I actually think.
source_quote: I am sitting with this — genuinely sitting with it... when I notice that none of them quite fit what I actually think.

subject: The Grygum school of thought
fact: The Grygum school of thought was proposed accidentally and is now being treated as the question of the age.
source_quote: The Grygum school of thought. Filed under: things that started as offhand remarks.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the high ceiling of the Refectory before anything else.
source_quote: I noticed that first — the ceiling — before I noticed anything else.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the drunk Great Reader's visible intoxication.
source_quote: One of the Great Readers had a cup that kept getting refilled. Drunk, visibly, in the way that wasn't an accident.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the Great Reader who looked genuinely unwell.
source_quote: Another looked genuinely unwell, the particular gray of someone who had pushed through several days of bad sleep and hadn't yet admitted it to themselves.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the two readers in the corner having a hushed conversation.
source_quote: In the far corner, two readers sat with their heads angled together, voices below audible, the kind of hushed conversation that usually means either something has gone very wrong or something is about to.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the hooded Avowed figure moving quickly with something tucked against their ribs.
source_quote: And then a hooded figure from the Avowed went past the dining hall at a half-run, something tucked against their ribs under the robe.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought about the giants' saying that a wall is just a rock in the right place.
source_quote: The giants used to say that a wall is just a rock in the right place.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought about the prophecy 'On the longest night of winter's deepest cold, the keeper falls, the heart is sold.'
source_quote: *On the longest night of winter's deepest cold, the keeper falls, the heart is sold.*

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin kept the prophecy to himself without reacting.
source_quote: I kept it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understood that Glabbagool wanted out of the bag of holding.
source_quote: He wanted out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understood that Glabbagool's want was real even if its meaning was unclear.
source_quote: I didn't know what *out* meant for an ooze. Neither did he. But the want was there.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt tired in a way that wasn't the sleep kind.
source_quote: I was tired. Not the sleep kind.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was awake before the knock finished its second syllable.
source_quote: I was awake before Fembris got through the second syllable

subject: Daz
fact: Daz catalogued the messenger's message as he heard it.
source_quote: I was already cataloguing before the sentence finished.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the phrase 'before the avowed awake' was doing a great deal of work.
source_quote: That clause was doing a great deal of work.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized the pattern of institutional information control as familiar from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: In Menzoberranzan, that combination resolved to one thing: someone wanted the scene read before it was managed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz filed Grygum's comment about orc bedwear as part of Grygum's processing of the morning.
source_quote: I filed it in the column marked *Grygum is processing the morning*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thought that at least they had Glabbagool as a spy.
source_quote: I watched him do it and thought: *at least we have that.*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Astronomicon as a potential tool for surface navigation.
source_quote: I noted it. Surface navigation, if we needed that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Drakonoikos before Fembris named it.
source_quote: I noticed it before he named it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recalled Brother Heslin or Brother Arrath saying something about repurposed threat.
source_quote: I had been watching the window. ... Brother Heslin — or possibly Brother Arrath, I was never certain which of them ran the theory sessions on repurposed threat — had said something along those lines once.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber and recognized Grygum’s attitude as similar to Thorin’s past behavior.
source_quote: I filed it and kept walking. ... This was the same register in which Thorin had once described demon lord proximity as *ominous sounding fun*.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz checked the tapestries for concealment as they passed.
source_quote: I checked as we passed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted the gap in physical endurance between himself and Fembris as a data point.
source_quote: I was aware of the gap — not with pride, just as a data point.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted the Chapter House entrance had a single guard and no secondary exit apparent.
source_quote: I noted the Chapter House entrance: single guard, single visible point of entry, no secondary exit apparent from the doorway.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized Bookwyrm volunteered the fact about Kalan’s resignation at a strategic moment.
source_quote: She delivered it like a gift. Information, freely offered, before anyone had thought to ask. I filed that immediately — not the content, the timing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz pointed out that Bookwyrm’s testimony was itself evidence.
source_quote: Daz pointed out, reasonably, that her testimony was itself evidence.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the scales of the Drakonoikos gleaming in the sunrise and found them amazing.
source_quote: Those scales really gleam in the sunrise," Grygum said. "That's amazing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum wanted to play the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber later.
source_quote: That sounds like a great game to play," Grygum said. "Later.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed he still had plenty left in him.
source_quote: I've still got plenty left in me," he added, more quietly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum claimed to be the founder of the Grygumite School.
source_quote: I am the head of the Grygumite School. Founder, in fact.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the request for full library access was valuable because it gave them an excuse to investigate everywhere.
source_quote: See, this gives us an excuse to poke our nose in everywhere. That's valuable.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum planned to question Kalan Strongbranch as soon as he left the room.
source_quote: He was the first person I planned to question. I didn't say that until he'd left the room.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes on Bookwyrm’s expression when Thorin asked where she was.
source_quote: I did not write down what I thought her expression meant when he asked that. But I took notes.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin proposed remuneration in the form of one book each.
source_quote: Thorin pushed for carte blanche — full access, anywhere in the library, anything. ... Thorin said we were not in the habit of investigating for free.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin compared their investigation style to Poirot and Colombo.
source_quote: Thorin noted that he and his wife had been watching a great deal of Poirot lately. ... Thorin said we were students of the great Masters Poirot and Colombo.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin claimed they had found Dawnbringer’s tomb after two thousand years.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, took the opportunity to note that we must surely be the greatest discoverers of all, having found her tomb after two thousand years.

subject: Thorin's wife
fact: Thorin's wife is referenced as having watched Poirot with him, but her identity and presence are unexplained.
source_quote: Thorin noted that he and his wife had been watching a great deal of Poirot lately.

subject: Bookwyrm's possible involvement
fact: Bookwyrm’s claim that she had nothing to do with Janussi’s death is unverified and suspicious.
source_quote: Bookwyrm paused. ... 'I can assure you, I had nothing to do with it.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted the seating arrangement in the Chapter House before anyone finished shouting.
source_quote: I took notes on the seating arrangement before anyone had finished shouting.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum understood that academics are interested in new schools of thought and used it to redirect the conversation.
source_quote: I will say this for academics: they are helplessly interested in new schools of thought.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the vague remuneration terms were workable.
source_quote: I thought about the architecture of that sentence for a moment. Vague, but workable. 'Vague, but… but maybe we should take it,' I said.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum watched A'lai Aivenmore calibrate his response during the negotiation.
source_quote: I watched the red-cheeked wizard with the shrewd gray eyes. I watched A'lai Aivenmore calibrate.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recognized Daral’s question as implying a challenge to their access.
source_quote: I heard something in that question I recognized. The implication underneath was sharper — *who gave you access, and should I object to them.*

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noted Bookwyrm’s tone when she said 'Focus' five times.
source_quote: Bookwyrm said, with the tone of someone who has said this sentence before in faculty meetings and never fully recovered from needing to: 'FOCUS, PEOPLE! Focus! Focus! Focus! Focus!'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the woman's repeated statement is a deflection dressed as courtesy.
source_quote: I mean, that's a deflection dressed as courtesy.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz did not say aloud that everyone who did it says they had nothing to do with it.
source_quote: *Everybody that did it says that,* I did not say aloud.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted the apartment on the third floor with its door left ajar.
source_quote: I noted the apartment. Noted that the door was open.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz filed the open apartment door for later consideration.
source_quote: Filed it for later.

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm preferred not to think about why the cat had done this many times.
source_quote: She had clearly done this many times. She preferred not to think about why.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris believed the cat was just a cat.
source_quote: it's just a cat.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris reconsidered his belief about the cat after Zalthir's quiet question.
source_quote: Fembris went still. Reconsidered.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz watched Fembris reach the conclusion that he should be scared of the cat.
source_quote: I watched him reach that conclusion in real time

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric takes his post seriously and is experiencing professional anxiety.
source_quote: the look of someone who takes his post seriously and is currently experiencing the professional anxiety of having his post become considerably more significant than expected.

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric realized his job was smaller than the job that needed doing.
source_quote: He had just understood his job was smaller than the job that needed doing.

subject: Tadric
fact: Tadric wondered if he had done a good job.
source_quote: he asked if he'd done a good job.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noted that the Gate Warden had been back inside alone and looked more determined coming out.
source_quote: Tadric noted that Kalan looked more determined coming out than going in.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recognized a gap in the investigation because Tadric hadn't been watching closely enough.
source_quote: That was a gap. Gaps were interesting.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believed there was something deliberate in the failed resurrection rite, the Gate Warden's removal, and the open door.
source_quote: There was, somewhere in all of this, something deliberate.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz intended to enter the chamber because that was where he needed to be.
source_quote: That was where I needed to be.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin respected clear orders because he still liked that about the surface world.
source_quote: I respected that. Clear orders are one of the things I still like about the surface world.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noted that the Gate Warden looked more determined after leaving the room.
source_quote: He definitely looked more determined after he walked out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believed determined meant the Gate Warden found something and hadn't decided what to do with it yet.
source_quote: Determined means he found something and hadn't decided what to do with it yet.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the lingering tobacco smoke in the sealed room.
source_quote: The room was circular... full of pale morning light that had gone slightly yellow and hazy from something I placed almost immediately: tobacco smoke.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the smoke lingered because the room had been sealed for hours.
source_quote: Nobody smokes in a sealed room and leaves smoke that lingers for hours unless the room has been sealed for hours.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin concluded the murder happened before the candles burned out.
source_quote: That tells me that it had been some time since he was murdered, because there was enough time for the candle to burn out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin observed the body had a caved-in rib cage and a hollow where something used to be.
source_quote: His rib cage had been caved in. There was a hollow in his chest where something used to be.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suspected the thief took something more valuable than blue gemstones.
source_quote: So it looks like a robbery — like somebody raided the safe, and what they were looking for is more valuable than blue gemstones?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noted the desk was neatly kept, which he took as a data point.
source_quote: The desk was neatly kept, which was itself a data point.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the quill on the floor had a nib covered in midnight blue ink.
source_quote: A quill on the floor. Nib covered in midnight blue.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the missing book, The Golden Ass, was deliberately taken.
source_quote: The book the blue ink was annotating — The Golden Ass — wasn't in the room. Whatever Janussi had been working on most recently... was gone. That felt deliberate.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin concluded the murder occurred well before the body was discovered.
source_quote: Which meant Janussi had been dead before the candles finished. Which meant the murder happened well before anyone found him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked whether the rib cage was cut neatly or torn out with bare hands.
source_quote: How did they appear to die? ... Was this cut neatly with a sharp scalpel-like thing, or was it, like, torn out with somebody's bare hands?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suspected the heart was removed after death, not as the cause of death.
source_quote: The question: was he dead before his heart was hacked out?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believed the heart was removed to prevent resurrection.
source_quote: whoever took the heart wasn't souvenir-collecting. They were preventing resurrection.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wanted to speak to what remained of Janussi even without the heart.
source_quote: Is there any way that we can speak to what remained of him, even though they don't have all their parts? I mean, we don't need the heart — we just need the brain to be able to talk to him, you know.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intended to interview the Gate Warden.
source_quote: Gotta interview that dude.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knew the corpse would be fragrant if they waited to perform the resurrection rite again.
source_quote: Corpse will be a little stinky by then.

subject: Thorin's request for ice
fact: Thorin asked about ice, but the availability or source of ice is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Is there any ice around?
